notes.subject: wantaim
notes.rationale: Hibru 'חגרו שק' i tok 'ol i bijim sak' nating; Tok Pisin i nidim 'wantaim' bilong tingim pasin.

notes.subject: ירד בבכי
notes.rationale: Hibru idiom 'i go daun long krai' — KJV 'weeping abundantly' JPS 'weeping profusely'; mi holim piksa bilong go daun.

notes.subject: ייליל
notes.rationale: Taim wantaim wantaim long 15:2 na 15:3 — 'yalal' i kamap tupela taim, narapela krai bilong Moab.

translation: Long ol rot bilong ⟨en⟩ ol i bijim ⟨wantaim⟩ sak bilong pen; long ol rup bilong haus bilong ⟨en⟩ na long ol bradples bilong ⟨en⟩, olgeta man i singaut nogut, i go daun long krai.

tokens.gloss: ol rup bilong haus bilong en
na long ol bradples bilong en
